faq: How big a boat can Man-O-War Marina take?
The marina has 23 slips for vessels up to 120 ft long with beams up to 20 ft, and takes drafts up to 7 ft even at low tide. Staff assist with docking on VHF 16.
Is there fuel on Man-O-War Cay?
Yes. The marina is the only fuelling station on the island, with gasoline and diesel at the dock (Mon-Sat 8am-12pm, 1pm-4pm) and at the roadside pump (Mon-Sat 9am-12pm, 2pm-4pm).
Can I use the showers and laundry if I am on a mooring?
No. Showers, laundry, the grill area and power are for marina guests only. The restaurant, gift store and fuel are open to everyone, and the office can fill your water tank on request.
How do I reserve a slip?
Call (242) 554-9500 or email mowmv@hotmail.com. The office is open Monday to Saturday, 8am to 12pm and 1pm to 4pm.
